description: Partial upsert one menu item: send only the fields to change; every omitted field (parent, sort, label, kind, ref, newTab, html/childTemplate/childShell/attrs/data) keeps its stored value, and parent: null moves it to the top level. A new id needs label, kind and ref (parent defaults to null, sort to the end). To remove rich keys, use put_menu_doc. A brand-new id dedupes by (menu, ref) — reuses an existing item linking the same target instead of creating a duplicate. An id that already names an item always updates that exact item, even if another item links the same page.
name: put_menu_item
